title: 10xEngineers EDA testplan
description: Maps specification features to coverage items (covergroups, coverpoints, bins, assertions, cover directives, tests). Loaded by the 10xEngineers EDA coverage dashboard.

goal.description: Default coverage goal (%) for every feature

features.description: Features / testpoints extracted from the specification

coverage.description: Coverage items: covergroup, covergroup::coverpoint, covergroup::coverpoint::bin ('*' wildcards allowed), cover:<directive>, code:<metric>

assertions.description: SVA assertion names that must pass non-vacuously

tests.description: Tests that must pass in the regression

stimulus.description: How the feature is exercised (sequence / test)
